svg.title: Youssef & Maii - Napkin: folded face 165 x 165 mm (330 mm napkin, quarter-fold - assumed TBC)
svg.desc: Minimal gold monogram centred on the folded face of an ivory napkin. Hot-foil napkin printers specify their own print area. FINAL DIELINE, PRINTABLE AREA, SCALE, BLEED AND SAFE AREA MUST BE CONFIRMED AGAINST THE MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE BEFORE PRODUCTION.

g.inkscape:label: GUIDES - NON-PRINTING (trim / bleed / safe / physical elements)
